description: Elixir wraps the reduction inside Enum.into/2,3 and a for ... into: comprehension in try: if the reduction raises, the collector receives :halt before the exception is re-raised. fz-sc8.12 and fz-sc8.17 land without this because try/rescue is not on this stack (fz-3ul). Unobservable for List, Map and MapSet collectors, whose :halt arm returns :ok with no external effect; it matters for any collector with side effects (IO streams, files). Add the try around the reduction in Enum.into/2,3 and in the comprehension rewrite's into: finishing form once fz-3ul's try/rescue has landed; oracle fixture: a collector that records :halt, a reduction that raises, elixir agreement on three paths.
title: Enum.into and for into: tell the collector :halt when the reduction raises
